Workfront organizes, prioritizes, tracks and manages the work and its resources.

source.title: Experience League: Integrate with Marketo Engage (Journey Optimizer)

connection_how: A Journey Optimizer custom action of type Adobe Marketo Engage sends person and custom object data from a journey into Marketo Engage; buying group and account journeys on Marketo data belong to Journey Optimizer B2B Edition, a separate product.
product_facts: There are two documented routes. The simpler one: forms built in Marketo Engage are embedded on the site's pages with Marketo's own embed code, so each submission is a Marketo form fill. We would place the embed in a reusable page component, agree the fields, consent wording and validation with you, and collect only the data you approve. Marketo's form prefill does not work with the embed code.

The fuller one: AEM Forms adaptive forms with the Submit to Marketo Engage action, which add a rule editor, prefill and a PDF record of each submission, and can connect to Adobe Sign for e-signatures. We would use embedded Marketo forms for standard lead capture and adaptive forms where a form needs that logic.

Journey Optimizer is Adobe's application for creating and delivering connected, personalized customer experiences across your channels. It is built on Adobe Experience Platform and its real-time customer profile, and runs both real-time journeys and scheduled campaigns.
Journey Optimizer orchestrates the journeys and campaigns and delivers the messages across channels.

We would set Journey Optimizer up in the order Adobe documents: the environment first, with a development sandbox for building and testing and a production sandbox for sending, each with its own channel configurations. Journeys are tested with test profiles before activation.

A journey automates a real-time, multi-step sequence of interactions; a campaign sends a scheduled or API-triggered message to an audience. Messages are delivered through channels like email, mobile messages, push notifications and direct mail.

product_facts: Brand Concierge is Adobe's platform for conversational experiences on your website, mobile apps and other digital properties. Every conversation is grounded in your own content and guardrails.
Brand Concierge answers visitors' questions from the content you approve.

Brand Concierge answers only from the knowledge sources you configure (website pages, PDFs and product spreadsheets), not from general world knowledge. Website sources refresh on a schedule you set, so answers keep up with the pages you publish.

When a question falls outside those sources, the concierge is designed to say it does not have the information rather than generate an unsupported answer, and guardrails can exclude topics such as legal or compliance matters.

Brand Concierge is focused on anonymous visitors: it answers from the conversation and your knowledge sources, not from an individual customer's records. Questions about a customer's own account would go to your secure channels.

Before launch, it is tested against a golden set of real customer questions paired with ideal answers, including questions it should not answer; after launch, conversation transcripts are reviewed on a recurring basis.

product_facts: There are two documented routes. source.title: Experience League: Destinations (Marketo Optimizer)

connection_how: Your lists in Marketo Optimizer are sent to your audiences on LinkedIn, Google and Facebook. When a person joins or leaves a list, or reaches a chosen step in a journey, the ad audience is updated to match.
product_facts: Marketo Optimizer is Adobe's AI-first marketing automation solution: it brings your lead, account and buying group journeys together with AI reasoning and next-best actions across your marketing, media and business development channels.
Marketo Optimizer runs the person journeys on your Marketo Engage data, with AI choosing the path for each person.

We would set up access with a user group in the Admin Console and a role in Experience Platform for each user type. For email, we would create channel configurations that bind a sending subdomain, IP pool and sender identity, a one-time administrator activity.

Marketo Optimizer's person journeys use your Marketo Engage data. When a qualifying activity is logged in Marketo Engage for a lead, the person can enter a journey immediately, and journey actions can request a campaign or change a person's status in a Marketo Engage program.

On a Next best path node you describe your intent in natural language and the system determines the most relevant path for each person. You can review, modify or override any AI recommendation before activating the journey, and each decision is logged with its reasoning.

The Coworker chat panel is embedded throughout Marketo Optimizer: your team uses plain language to build programs and journeys, compare people lists, and explore email performance and journey metrics as charts and tables. Each action is checked against the permissions the feature needs outside chat.

source.title: Experience League: Coworker chat interface (Marketo Optimizer)

connection_how: Coworker is the chat panel inside Marketo Optimizer. Your marketers describe what they need or upload a campaign brief, and Coworker sets up the program, lists and journeys for them to review. It can only do what each person's permissions allow, and it creates nothing until that person says to go ahead.
product_facts: Coworker is Adobe's AI-powered teammate for customer experience and marketing workflows. You describe a goal in plain language, and it plans the work, executes it across your Adobe and connected systems, validates the results and brings the finished work back for your approval.
Coworker lets your teams ask for insights, content and actions across your Adobe applications in natural language.

We would tailor Coworker to the way your teams work with skills: reusable playbooks that standardize common workflows, reporting methods and analysis approaches, so nobody has to explain the same process again.

You keep control through approval gates, permissions inherited from your Adobe organization, checks before actions run and an audit trail. Skills do not store customer data: data access stays governed through your connected Adobe applications, permissions and organizational controls.
Coworker acts across Adobe and external systems through governed access, using built-in connectors or your own. An external tool or service is connected by adding it as a server.
As Coworker takes on a task you can watch it reason and progress. It validates the results and brings the finished work back to you for approval.

product_facts: Brand Concierge is Adobe's platform for conversational experiences on your website, mobile apps and other digital properties. Every conversation is grounded in your own content and guardrails.
Brand Concierge answers visitors' questions from the content you approve.

Brand Concierge answers only from the knowledge sources you configure (website pages, PDFs and product spreadsheets), not from general world knowledge. Website sources refresh on a schedule you set, so answers keep up with the pages you publish.

When a question falls outside those sources, the concierge is designed to say it does not have the information rather than generate an unsupported answer, and guardrails can exclude topics such as legal or compliance matters.

Brand Concierge is focused on anonymous visitors: it answers from the conversation and your knowledge sources, not from an individual customer's records. Questions about a customer's own account would go to your secure channels.

Before launch, it is tested against a golden set of real customer questions paired with ideal answers, including questions it should not answer; after launch, conversation transcripts are reviewed on a recurring basis.

source.title: Experience League: Marketo Qualifier, Set up Marketing Highlights

connection_how: Your Marketo Engage sends live activity, such as email opens and clicks, web visits and form fills, to Marketo Qualifier, where your representatives see and filter prospects by it. Outreach from Marketo Qualifier is written back to Marketo Engage as activities.
product_facts: There are two documented routes. The simpler one: forms built in Marketo Engage are embedded on the site's pages with Marketo's own embed code, so each submission is a Marketo form fill. We would place the embed in a reusable page component, agree the fields, consent wording and validation with you, and collect only the data you approve. Marketo's form prefill does not work with the embed code.

The fuller one: AEM Forms adaptive forms with the Submit to Marketo Engage action, which add a rule editor, prefill and a PDF record of each submission, and can connect to Adobe Sign for e-signatures. We would use embedded Marketo forms for standard lead capture and adaptive forms where a form needs that logic.
Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform, a single solution that lets you attract, segment and nurture your customers. Each marketing initiative runs as a program.
Marketo Engage runs the marketing programs that attract, segment and nurture your customers.

We would configure the admin settings, including CNAMEs and Marketo's JavaScript tracking code, Munchkin, which tracks the people who visit your website so that automated campaigns can react to their visits. We would test the automation workflows and the data sync before launch.
Campaigns run as Smart Campaigns. A Smart List defines who you want to target, using filters and triggers, and the flow sets the steps the campaign performs, including wait steps and split choices.

services.adobe_quote: You can connect the following objects from Adobe Experience Manager Assets:

source.title: Experience League: Connected record types overview (Workfront Planning)

connection_how: Your plans in Workfront Planning are linked to the images, folders and content fragments in AEM Assets that belong to them, and your assets can carry details from the plan.
product_facts: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service is Adobe's cloud-native solution for digital asset management and Dynamic Media. It helps you maximize the value of your digital assets across creation, management and delivery.
AEM Assets is the repository where your digital assets are managed, enriched and delivered.

To bring your existing library across, Bulk Import lets administrators import large numbers of assets directly from an external data source in a single operation. AEM applies smart tags to uploaded assets automatically, by default.

People find the right asset through smart tags, customized metadata and enhanced search. Metadata forms let you add your own business-specific fields to an asset's details page, and we would agree those fields with you before the assets are loaded.
For distribution, Content Hub centralizes and distributes approved brand and marketing content. Only assets marked Approved in AEM Assets become available there.
Asset reports show how the system is used, how users interact with assets and which assets are shared.

services.name: Coworker access and tool permissions for Planning
services.scope: Have your client's Workfront administrator enable Coworker, choose the read-only and write tools, allow the panel in the right access levels, and check that Coworker acts only within each user's Planning permissions.
services.adobe_quote: Your Workfront administrator must select the Read-only and Write-only MCP tools in the System Preferences area of Setup.

source.title: Experience League: Adobe Workfront Planning CX Enterprise Coworker overview

connection_how: Your planners ask Coworker, inside Workfront, to find, create, update and link records in Workfront Planning. Coworker shows what it will do and waits for a yes, and every change is logged.
product_facts: Workfront Planning gives you visibility into the operational details of your organization. You decide which record types you use, such as campaigns, and how they link to one another and to object types from other systems.
Workfront Planning gives visibility into the operational details of your organization, in record types you define and link to one another.

We would build your workspaces from a predefined template or with your own record types and fields, and define how the record types relate to one another. Each record type can have a request form, so people add records by submitting it.
Records open in a table view by default, and you can also create a timeline or a calendar view of them.

Record types connect to one another and to objects from other applications. A campaign record type connected to a Workfront project can bring the project's planned completion date onto the record. Each connected application needs its own license and account.
You share workspaces with users, groups, teams, companies and job roles. Sharing a workspace also shares its record types, records and fields; views are shared separately.
